827f08b1f4b0.name: Pandawa Beach

66b1f0ec759e.address: Jl. Raya Abang, Ababi, Abang, Karangasem, Bali 80852

96fa10c1fc27.name: Lunamoon Coffee & Thai Kitchen
96fa10c1fc27.description: Coffee shop and Thai restaurant on the Penelokan ridge with views of Batur volcano and a terrace above the slope.

96fa10c1fc27.address: Jl. Raya Penelokan, Batur Tengah, Kintamani, Bangli, Bali 80652

9d031930ee58.name: Nusa Lembongan
9d031930ee58.description: Island with beaches and turquoise water.

7e5dbff763f0.name: Arna
7e5dbff763f0.description: Swimming pool club on a cliff above the ocean, Nusa Ceningan.

359600659e24.name: Suku Beach Club
359600659e24.description: White sand beach club with pool, Nusa Ceningan.

532de38572fc.name: Kelingking Beach
532de38572fc.description: Viewpoint and beach near a dinosaur-shaped rock, Nusa Penida.

24558afa16f3.name: Rumah Pohon Tree House
24558afa16f3.description: A treehouse on a cliff overlooking the rocky islets and coastline off Atuh Beach.

8b87bc7dbc53.name: Paluang Cliff
8b87bc7dbc53.description: Lookout at Kelingking with a side view of the cape and a wooden boat for photos over the cliff.
8b87bc7dbc53.recommendation: Leave for 30–60 minutes; The panorama opens without going down to the beach; do not approach the edge of the cliff.

d0798813c4da.name: Porch
d0798813c4da.description: Cafe offering 13 varieties of syrniki, chosen using illustrated cards.
d0798813c4da.note: Profile in the post: @porch.bali. A match with The Porch Cafe in Sanur has not been confirmed.

bf3b94e1d462.name: Mamu Garden
bf3b94e1d462.description: Restaurant in a glass conservatory; the post mentions desserts, octopus and salmon.
bf3b94e1d462.note: The venue in the post has not been reliably matched to the similarly named restaurant in central Ubud.

8c1d0af955c3.name: Feel Food
8c1d0af955c3.description: Cafe serving baked potatoes with fillings and salmon crepes.
8c1d0af955c3.note: The exact address has not been established.

89f4aaacde2e.name: Swan Paradise
89f4aaacde2e.description: Tennis court on the grass among palm trees, there is also padel.
89f4aaacde2e.note: A connection with the Pramana hotel in Gianyar has not been confirmed.

1528b5ee2391.name: House of Kairos
1528b5ee2391.description: Club hotel with a gym, a striped pool, a sauna and a cafe.
1528b5ee2391.note: Profile in the post: @house_of_kairos. The exact address has not been established.

e426a43f1401.name: Sauna with ocean view
e426a43f1401.description: Glass-fronted sauna above a beach, shown at sunset in the video.
e426a43f1401.note: The name Holywings Wellness Club was suggested in the comments; a match to the sauna in the video has not been confirmed.

abf808579d10.name: Indonesian Food Festival
abf808579d10.description: Past Indonesian food festival at Discovery Mall in Kuta.

696212bc3632.name: Aetheria Natural Healing Spa
696212bc3632.recommendation: Select Balinese X Aroma Massage for 60 minutes; You can sign up through Fresha.
696212bc3632.note: Approximate location: located on Jl street. Karang Suwung, Google Maps link opens the exact location.
696212bc3632.address: Jl. Karang Suwung No. 1A, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

f03c5680cae6.name: 32do Bali

f03c5680cae6.recommendation: Try Bingsu Original Strawberry or Kyoto Matcha, from coffee - Einspanner.
f03c5680cae6.address: Jl. Lebak Sari / Jl. Petitenget No.77, Kerobokan Kelod, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361

96a82a86deb8.name: La Brisa Sunday Market
96a82a86deb8.description: Sunday market for local producers at La Brisa near Echo Beach.
96a82a86deb8.recommendation: Come on Sunday from 10:00 to 16:00 - these are the market hours, they are different from the hours of the club itself.
96a82a86deb8.address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali, Indonesia

ca9759a58903.name: Kecak Dance Amphitheater Uluwatu Temple
ca9759a58903.description: An outdoor amphitheater at the Uluwatu Temple, where they show the Kecak dance against the backdrop of the ocean.
ca9759a58903.recommendation: Choose a sunset show and book your ticket in advance: seats are limited.
ca9759a58903.address: 539P+J4, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali, Indonesia

02c550f4de08.name: SMOKE Canggu
02c550f4de08.description: Grill restaurant with cocktails and a romantic evening atmosphere.
02c550f4de08.recommendation: The author recommends it in the evening for a date.
02c550f4de08.address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan No.69, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

da2876b3eb31.name: SATOSHI
da2876b3eb31.description: Japanese-Italian cuisine in a wabi-sabi interior. Google guests praise the atmosphere and service, while some criticise flavour combinations and nigiri rice. The author highlights fusion cuisine and DJ music.
da2876b3eb31.recommendation: Google guests recommend barramundi in citrus sauce and Japanese curry risotto. The author suggests dinner and conversation with DJ music.
da2876b3eb31.address: Satoshi, Jl. Bumbak No.55, Kerobokan, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia

e39775a3295b.name: Riviera Bistro
e39775a3295b.description: Bistro with an emphasis on seafood and European interior.
e39775a3295b.recommendation: For an aperitif, come from 16:00 to 19:00; on Saturday from 20:00 dinner turns into an evening with DJs.
e39775a3295b.address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

ab39c6083524.name: MOSTO
ab39c6083524.description: Non-bistro with a relaxed European atmosphere and natural wines.
ab39c6083524.recommendation: Come after 17:00 for natural wine and food for company; cocktail alternative - MOSTO mule.
ab39c6083524.address: Mosto | Berawa, Jl. Pantai Berawa No.8, Tibubeneng, Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia

7ca77e04ddd0.name: Cinta Pererenan
7ca77e04ddd0.description: Cozy bistro: coffee and food during the day, wine in the evening.
7ca77e04ddd0.recommendation: For breakfast, arrive from 08:00; You can bring your dog on the green outdoor terrace.
7ca77e04ddd0.address: 944H+C7X, Jl. Pantai Pererenan, 92, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

8fd95de6ba85.name: Pescado Pererenan
8fd95de6ba85.description: Spanish cuisine with an emphasis on seafood.
8fd95de6ba85.address: Pescado Bali, Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.112, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung Regency, Bali 80351, Indonesia

b3309914cf47.name: Lulu Bistrot
b3309914cf47.description: French bistro with bar and relaxed atmosphere for a romantic evening.
b3309914cf47.recommendation: For a tasting dinner, book the Chef's Counter: only six seats and a four-serve menu.
b3309914cf47.address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.72, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

4d19ff1c2fe1.name: Bar Vera
4d19ff1c2fe1.description: Wine bar and European bistro from the MASONRY team, in Pererenana.
4d19ff1c2fe1.address: Bar Vera Bistro & Wine Bar, Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.84, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia

eae9e1b8a76c.name: Santanera
eae9e1b8a76c.description: Great restaurant for dinner with friends or a date, with Latin American and Mediterranean flavors.
eae9e1b8a76c.recommendation: Order several dishes for the table: the menu with grilling, smoking and fermentation is designed for joint tasting.
eae9e1b8a76c.address: Santanera, Jl. Tanah Barak No.55-57, Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80351, Indonesia

9de81956c633.name: 2MOODS (Two Moods)
9de81956c633.recommendation: The post recommends crepes with caviar.
9de81956c633.address: Jl. Tanah Barak No.47, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia

14091f0ac8b1.name: BAKED. Pererenan
14091f0ac8b1.description: Bakery with coffee, fresh pastries and breakfasts.
14091f0ac8b1.recommendation: For breakfast - Original Best Scramble on sourdough bread; This branch has open seating.
14091f0ac8b1.address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.118, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia

37b8f49ede6c.name: HUBBLE Space Cemagi
37b8f49ede6c.description: Oceanfront restaurant in Cemagi serving Asian food, Ukrainian dishes and breakfast.
37b8f49ede6c.recommendation: According to reviews on Google Maps, lunch cost one guest 150–175 thousand rupees per person, dinner for another - from 250 thousand. One of the guests noted that access for a wheelchair is difficult.
37b8f49ede6c.address: Jl. Umalalang, Cemagi, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

da6caebb1e6c.name: BAKED. Batu Bolong
da6caebb1e6c.description: Bakery-coffee shop with a spacious interior and breakfast.
da6caebb1e6c.recommendation: The review recommends scrambled eggs and fresh pastries.
da6caebb1e6c.address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.97, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

fd04f62f73ca.name: Copenhagen Berawa
fd04f62f73ca.recommendation: Bread and raspberry jam for cheese. The author recommends the branch in Berawa: more space and fewer queues.
fd04f62f73ca.address: Gg. Anggrek, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361

ebcf98369534.name: Honey
ebcf98369534.description: Daytime cafe serving brunch in Pererenan.
ebcf98369534.recommendation: Try the toast with peach, ricotta and local honey; The cafe is open during the day, until 18:00.
ebcf98369534.address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.132, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung, Bali 80351

f90cfdead4c5.name: Sisterfields
f90cfdead4c5.description: Australian style cafe serving breakfast and brunch.
f90cfdead4c5.recommendation: For lunch - Short Ribs Rigatoni with stewed beef; Small companies are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.
f90cfdead4c5.address: Jl. Kayu Cendana No.7, Kerobokan Kelod, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361

b9e53871d7aa.name: HUT by Shelter
b9e53871d7aa.description: Cafe and bakery formerly known as Shelter Café.
b9e53871d7aa.recommendation: Come in the morning for croissants and home-baked bread; The bakery and deli are open from 07:00 to 17:00.
b9e53871d7aa.address: Jl. Drupadi 1 No.2b, Seminyak, Kuta, Badung, Bali 80361

c0b8dd9bdf5c.name: Nook
c0b8dd9bdf5c.description: Cafe with Asian and Western cuisine in Umalas.
c0b8dd9bdf5c.recommendation: Try Nasi Campur Special or Ayam Betutu from the popular dishes section.
c0b8dd9bdf5c.address: Jalan Umalas 1, Jl. Nook No.1, Kerobokan Kelod, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361

dab211d8034d.name: Bumbak Coffee
dab211d8034d.description: Coffee shop serving brunch in Umalas.
dab211d8034d.recommendation: For coffee - choose manual brewing from the Manual Brewing section; There's also jamu and kombucha.
dab211d8034d.address: Jl. Bumbak No.170, Kerobokan, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361

e7ee5dd4b4ae.name: Yellow Flower Café
e7ee5dd4b4ae.description: Family cafe in a garden on a hill in Sayan; predominantly plant-based menu.
e7ee5dd4b4ae.recommendation: Try Nasi Campur Campuhan or Cold Brew Cashew Coffee; To get to the cafe you need to walk along the steps of Penestanan.
e7ee5dd4b4ae.address: Jl. Raya Campuhan, Sayan, Ubud, Bali 80571

771164040f17.name: Clear Café Ubud
771164040f17.description: Cafe with vegetarian, vegan and raw food dishes; eat seafood.
771164040f17.recommendation: Choose Dragon Bowl with tofu or tempeh or Golden Temple Curry; Seafood options are listed separately.
771164040f17.address: Jl. Hanoman No.8, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571

67226ac09a17.name: Moksa Ubud
67226ac09a17.description: Plant-based restaurant with a permaculture garden in Sayan.
67226ac09a17.recommendation: Try Tempeh Ribs or Asam Laksa Noodle from the chef's recommendations; last order at 20:30.
67226ac09a17.address: Ubud II Kutuh, Jl. Puskesmas, Sayan, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571

83cff7a95bd2.name: Land’s End Café
83cff7a95bd2.description: Breakfast and brunch cafe near Suluban.
83cff7a95bd2.recommendation: Come for breakfast and French press coffee in the morning; In the review, breakfasts are indicated until 15:00.
83cff7a95bd2.address: Jl. Pantai Suluban No.18, Uluwatu, Pecatu, Bali

b5b0133c2cc2.name: Tanah Uluwatu
b5b0133c2cc2.description: Bakery and grill restaurant serving breakfast and brunch.
b5b0133c2cc2.recommendation: For a family visit, there are children's dishes; Car and motorcycle parking is free.
b5b0133c2cc2.address: Jl. Raya Uluwatu Pecatu No.000, Pecatu, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali 80361

2eeefebf31b7.name: Virgin Beach
2eeefebf31b7.description: Beach in eastern Bali, in the Karangasem area. The selection shows a view of the coast and Mount Agung.
2eeefebf31b7.recommendation: Small warungs on the beach serve lunch.

4e4dd3eae944.name: Handara Golf & Resort Bali
4e4dd3eae944.description: Golf resort in the mountains near Bedugul with fields among green slopes.
4e4dd3eae944.recommendation: The selection recommends playing golf or tennis.
4e4dd3eae944.address: Jl. Raya Bedugul, Pancasari, Buleleng, Bali

cfd609831906.name: Gajah Putih
cfd609831906.description: Restaurant with gastronomic dinner and theatrical performance of Balinese traditions.
cfd609831906.recommendation: Book the dinner show in advance and not be late: servings are synchronized with the performance and are not repeated for latecomers.
cfd609831906.address: Jl. Raya Mawang No.88, Lodtunduh, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali

283052dcfb09.name: Diamond Beach
283052dcfb09.description: Beach in the east of Nusa Penida under high cliffs.

0b508bf8dfe8.name: Broken Beach
0b508bf8dfe8.description: A round bay on Nusa Penida with a natural stone arch connecting it to the ocean.
0b508bf8dfe8.address: Bunga Mekar, Nusa Penida, Klungkung, Bali

17663d27fafa.name: RIUG Paragliding
17663d27fafa.description: Paragliding along coastal cliffs and the ocean.
17663d27fafa.recommendation: Choose a tandem with a pilot; the flight usually takes 10–15 minutes, the departure depends on the wind and the pilot's decision.
17663d27fafa.address: Jl. Villa Shanti No.Br, Sawangan, Benoa, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali

8e0f6ecbfcb8.name: Melasti Beach
8e0f6ecbfcb8.description: Beach under limestone cliffs in Ungasan with open views of the ocean.
8e0f6ecbfcb8.recommendation: For swimming, stay in the area between the flags; At low tide, coral areas are exposed.
8e0f6ecbfcb8.address: Jl. Melasti Ungasan, Ungasan, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali 80361

514b2c9cbc63.name: Rame Cafe Jimbaran
514b2c9cbc63.description: Seafood restaurant with tables on the sand; In the author's photo - grilled fish and shrimp.
514b2c9cbc63.recommendation: In the seafood menu, the price is per 100 g - agree on the weight of the fish or shrimp before cooking.
514b2c9cbc63.address: Pantai Muaya, Jl. Four Seasons, Jimbaran, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali 80361

7e9ef90d4345.name: Kurasu Pererenan
7e9ef90d4345.description: Coffee and matcha overlooking the rice fields. Branch of the Japanese chain in Pererenan.
7e9ef90d4345.address: Jl. Babadan No.89, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia

6276c85a8752.name: Oaken Lab — Pererenan
6276c85a8752.description: Indonesian brand boutique: perfumes, body products and home fragrances. On the ground floor of the brick Further Hotel building.
6276c85a8752.address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.68, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia

702ea5c4eda2.name: Nautilus
702ea5c4eda2.description: Google reviewers praise the seafood and attentive service. The post author highlights the aquarium and unusual presentation.
702ea5c4eda2.recommendation: Google reviewers recommend oysters and seafood pasta.
702ea5c4eda2.address: Jl. Suweta No.80, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia

e5f7e19ec80c.name: FERRO Grill Restaurant & Bar
e5f7e19ec80c.description: Google reviews published on the restaurant website praise the plating, cozy setting and attentive staff. The post author recommends it for a romantic dinner with live music.
e5f7e19ec80c.recommendation: Google guests highlight Hamachi Crudo and prawns. The post author suggests tartare, lobster, steak, octopus and Pavlova.
e5f7e19ec80c.address: Jl. Bisma No.63x, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80671, Indonesia

a05e6b24c2c7.name: Lava Gastrobar & Grill
a05e6b24c2c7.description: Google reviewers praise the plating, service and volcano-themed decor. The post author highlights volcanic-stone grilling and live-music evenings.
a05e6b24c2c7.recommendation: Author: chicken liver pâté and Lava Choux. Google guests: prawn fettuccine and mushroom risotto.
a05e6b24c2c7.address: Jl. Danau Poso No.51 A, Semawang, Sanur, Denpasar Selatan, Denpasar City, Bali 80228, Indonesia

483ca61dcfda.name: TONYRAKA Art Lounge
483ca61dcfda.description: Google guests highlight the peaceful courtyard, art around the tables and generous portions. The post author suggests dinner in the gallery and a walk to the rice fields.
483ca61dcfda.recommendation: The author highlights lamb slow-cooked for seven hours. One Google review says duck, chicken and salad were plenty for two hungry diners.
483ca61dcfda.address: Jl. Raya Mas No.86, Mas, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571, Indonesia

ac456332f012.name: Cantina Rooftop
ac456332f012.description: Google guests praise the views and cocktails; one review found the food short on flavour. The author highlights the temple views and rooftop dinner.
ac456332f012.recommendation: Author: jerk chicken, perch or pasta. Google guests: chicken liver parfait and mango soufflé; one review reports about 20 minutes for the soufflé.
ac456332f012.address: Sayan, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571, Indonesia

7a5fa20e90f4.name: Locavore NXT
7a5fa20e90f4.description: Google reviews highlight unusual local ingredients, fermentation and the progression through different spaces during dinner. The author highlights the tasting format and unexpected combinations.
7a5fa20e90f4.recommendation: Author: spiny lobster with pineapple and lemongrass. Google guests highlight mushroom and vegetable dishes and the fermentation-lab tour.
7a5fa20e90f4.address: Jl. A.A. Gede Rai Gang Pura Panti Bija, Lodtunduh, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571, Indonesia

156fea0f3a9c.name: Red Gunpowder
156fea0f3a9c.description: Google guests highlight the low lighting, Indian music and friendly service. The author suggests the open terrace for a date.
156fea0f3a9c.recommendation: Author: Butter Chicken Masala with naan. Google guests: pastry-topped chicken biryani, garlic and cheese naan, and garam masala pumpkin.
156fea0f3a9c.address: Jl. Munduk Tengah No.6, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung Regency, Bali 80351, Indonesia

7a3b988954a1.name: Syrco BASÈ
7a3b988954a1.description: Google guests praise the textures, stories behind each course and drink pairings. The author highlights contemporary Indonesian cuisine and a tasting dinner that tells a connected story.
7a3b988954a1.recommendation: The author suggests a tasting dinner. Google reviews recommend the bar before or after dinner, Claypot Negroni and Zest & Berry.
7a3b988954a1.address: Jl. Sri Wedari No.72, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571, Indonesia

ad438f4bb368.name: KAJA by NUMA
ad438f4bb368.description: Google guests highlight the unusual cave-like room and caring service; one review found the steaks and sauce too salty. The author highlights warm lighting and an intimate atmosphere.
ad438f4bb368.recommendation: Author: signature pizza and grilled octopus. Google guests also praise the arancini and prawns.
ad438f4bb368.address: Jl. Raya Pengosekan Ubud, Mas, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571, Indonesia
